_comment: Illustrated site maps: AI-generated block dioramas (Higgsfield nano_banana_2) traced from Orrery's own reference maps of LROC / HiRISE imagery and the mission traverse data. Shown in the site panel's STORY tab (first card) and on /moon/<id> and /mars/<id>; listed on /colophon. validate-data checks that the file and its ladder rungs exist.
